sources.role: Default Fin comparison normalization must not be combined bidirectionally with Fin.lt_def
Original Fin value comparison equivalence, no order change
sources.raw_excerpt:
/-! ### order -/

theorem le_def {a b : Fin n} : a ≤ b ↔ a.1 ≤ b.1 := .rfl

theorem lt_def {a b : Fin n} : a < b ↔ a.1 < b.1 := .rfl

@[deprecated lt_def (since := "2025-10-26")]

@[simp] theorem ite_true (a b : α) : (if True then a else b) = a := rfl
@[simp] theorem ite_false (a b : α) : (if False then a else b) = b := rfl

sources.role: Same forall predicate set as indexed intersection
sources.raw_excerpt:
theorem ofPred_forall (p : ι → β → Prop) : { x | ∀ i, p i x } = ⋂ i, { x | p i x } :=
  ext fun _ => .symm <| mem_iInter

@[deprecated (since := "2026-07-09")] alias setOf_forall := ofPred_forall
